name: Brisen

attributes.attribute: an Arthurian heroine and a magician
got Lancelot drunk to trick him
arranged for Lancelot to spend the night with Elaine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brisen is an Arthurian heroine and a magician. She was the friend of Elaine of Corbenic. This Elaine loved the knight Lancelot. Lancelot loved the queen Guinevere. Brisen made Lancelot drunk. She whispered that the queen waited in a secret chamber. He found a beautiful woman there. He spent the night with her. He woke to Brisen's trickery.

okr.objective: Describe Brisen, the Arthurian magician who tricked Lancelot for her friend.
key_results: Brisen was an Arthurian heroine and a magician.
She was the friend of Elaine of Corbenic.
She made Lancelot drunk to bring him to Elaine.
Lancelot woke to find he had been tricked.
